snippet.title: Back of Beyond - Trailer Movie
snippet.description:
Back of Beyond

An occult strategy card roguelike. Recruit animal villagers, build a follower deck, and place facilities to turn Faith and Devotion into Eldritch Power. Defend Mist Town from invading Eldritch Gods and grow your secret cult.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539480/
